entities.name: Prophet Muhammad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prophet and founder of Islam (c. 570–632 CE). Received revelations compiled as the Quran, united the Arabian Peninsula, and established the political and religious community (ummah) that would expand into one of history's largest civilizations.
